content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides whether witnesses for D2 vs C3 count as unanswered and whether a retraction cures them, which is what K-G4 governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"the line is cured by retraction, not defended: every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.
